class.name: fr3wml_industrial_bt/FairinoMoveLBackend
class.description: CartesianBackend plugin for Fairino FR3WML robots. Delegates TCP linear motion to fairino_bridge's ExecutePoseMotion service (/fairino/movel_pose) which calls the vendor SDK movel. Converts the incoming TCP pose to a flange pose using a YAML-configurable flange offset (wrist3->flange).
